headers.comment: Photos are the bulk of the page weight and rarely change. One day fresh, then a week of serving stale while revalidating in the background. Renaming a file busts its cache immediately, so swap photos by changing the filename if you need it live at once.

CSS and JS are deliberately NOT cached long. The filenames are not content-hashed, so a long max-age would strand visitors on stale code after an edit. Vercel's edge still caches these; only the browser revalidates.
